newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish bottled water market up in 1996-Ballgowan.
newsitem.headline: Irish bottled water market up in 1996-Ballgowan.

text.p: The Irish bottled water market continued to grow in 1996, with consumption levels up 1.5 percent on 1995, a review by bottled water group Ballygowan, said on Monday.
Ballygowan, which is owned by Cantrell & Cochrane, said the Irish market consumed a total of 40 million litres of bottled water in 1996.

"Ballygowan continued to perform excellently in this dynamic and very competitive market, maintaining its dominant position as market leader, with over 60 percent market share," Ballygowan said in a statement.
It said although consumption was still low by international standards, this growth indicated an increase in per capita consumption to 11.5 litres in 1996 up from five litres in 1991.
